subject: ready-for-life
standards: Manuel Academy Ready for Life elementary sequence — Grade 3
Ready for Life v1 safety, supervision, and no-shame policy reference
Manuel Academy RFL G3 Unit 3 — kitchen helper safety and no-heat preparation
instructions: Complete the task or its stated simulation alternative. Do not submit photos, recordings, addresses, account details, or private household information.
Learner completion never certifies a guardian-authority task; those tasks remain pending until a guardian attests.

learnerTasks.directions: Before touching any ingredient, look at the two or three snack options your adult offers and pick one.
learnerTasks.prompt: Name the snack you picked and list the ingredients it needs.

learnerTasks.directions: Before assembling, wash your hands, gather only the ingredients and tools your snack needs, and check that no sharp knife, stove, or appliance is part of your plan.
learnerTasks.prompt: I washed my hands before touching any ingredient.

learnerTasks.directions: Before assembling, wash your hands, gather only the ingredients and tools your snack needs, and check that no sharp knife, stove, or appliance is part of your plan.
learnerTasks.prompt: I used only cold or room-temperature ingredients and did not turn on the stove, oven, or any appliance.

learnerTasks.directions: Before assembling, wash your hands, gather only the ingredients and tools your snack needs, and check that no sharp knife, stove, or appliance is part of your plan.
learnerTasks.prompt: I used only a butter knife or a spoon, not a sharp chef's knife.

learnerTasks.directions: Before assembling, wash your hands, gather only the ingredients and tools your snack needs, and check that no sharp knife, stove, or appliance is part of your plan.
learnerTasks.prompt: I kept any unwashed raw ingredient away from ingredients that were already ready to eat until it was washed.

learnerTasks.directions: With your adult watching the whole time, assemble your chosen snack from start to finish on a clean plate, then wipe the counter when you are done.
learnerTasks.prompt: Describe the order you assembled your snack in, step by step, from the first ingredient to the last.

learnerTasks.directions: Think about the whole process, not just the eating part.
learnerTasks.prompt: Name one specific step where you had to be extra careful and explain what you did to stay safe during that step.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated Tool boundary respected criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated Hygiene and separation criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated Process completion criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the assessed objective.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Kitchen Helper Safety?
